data.name: GuidanceActivityLevelBody
data.value: Choose the option that best matches your usual weekly activity. This helps estimate your daily energy needs.

data.name: GuidanceWeightBody
data.value: Measure under similar conditions each time, preferably at a consistent time of day and before eating.

data.name: GuidanceNeckBody
data.value: Place the tape around the neck below the larynx. Keep it level and snug without compressing the skin.

data.name: GuidanceAbdomenBody
data.value: Measure at navel level while standing relaxed. Do not pull your stomach in, and keep the tape level.

data.name: GuidanceWaistBody
data.value: Measure the narrowest part of your waist while standing relaxed, and use the same location each time.

data.name: GuidanceHipBody
data.value: Measure around the widest part of the hips and buttocks with the tape level and neither tight nor loose.

data.name: GuidanceBodyFatBody
data.value: This estimates the proportion of your body weight that is fat using your height and circumference measurements.

data.name: GuidanceBmrBody
data.value: This estimates the energy your body uses at rest from your weight, height, age, and profile information.

data.name: GuidanceTdeeBody
data.value: This estimates daily energy needs by combining basal metabolism with your selected activity level.

data.name: GuidanceReusedSizesBody
data.value: A weight-only entry reuses the latest available size measurements. Update the sizes when they change for more current estimates.

data.name: GuidanceEstimateDisclaimerBody
